invariants.rationale: The returned map should not be null since it is always initialized as a new LinkedHashMap<> before being populated and returned.
Each record could be mapped to only one partition; the number of keys in the result cannot exceed the number of input records.
The method expects a valid deduplicated record list as input; null checks would occur earlier.
The partitioner is used for grouping and must be non-null throughout the method.
All partitioned record lists in the map should be non-null and should not contain nulls, as only non-null records from dedupedRecords are processed.
